amount.stop.keep_moist: Water slowly until a little reaches the saucer, then stop. Tip out the saucer after ten minutes.
amount.stop.keep_moist.us: Water slowly until a little drains into the saucer, then stop. Dump the saucer after ten minutes.
amount.stop.let_top_dry: Water until it runs out of the bottom into the saucer, wait a few minutes, then tip the saucer out.
amount.stop.let_top_dry.us: Water until it runs out the bottom into the saucer, wait a few minutes, then dump the saucer.
amount.stop.let_fully_dry: Water well, in two rounds if the soil has pulled from the edge, until it runs through. Empty the saucer afterwards.
amount.noHole.stop: Water a little at a time.
amount.noHole.warning: This pot cannot drain. Water a little at a time and check the bottom, if you can.
amount.noHole.tip: Tip: move the plant into a pot with holes and keep this one as an outer pot.
amount.cachepot: Lift the inner pot out to water, let it drain, then put it back.
amount.selfWatering: Fill the reservoir, then wait until it is nearly empty before refilling.
tox.noneForHousehold: No known effect on the pets or children you listed in the sources read.
tox.petsNotAssessed: Not assessed for pets yet; treat it as possibly harmful.
tox.noneForPeople: No known effect on people in the sources read.
learn.heading: Learn more
learn.anySearch: Any reverse image search works: use a photo of the plant and see what names come up.
tox.label: Toxicity
tox.level.0.pets: No known effect in the sources read.
tox.level.1.pets: Mild: drooling, a sore mouth or an upset stomach; usually passes by itself.
tox.level.2.pets: Moderate: marked pain or swelling, or repeated vomiting; call a vet or an animal poison line.
tox.level.3.pets: Severe: can harm the heart, nerves or organs; an emergency, go to a vet at once.
tox.level.0.people: No known effect in the sources read.
tox.level.1.people: Mild: a sore mouth, skin irritation or an upset stomach; usually passes by itself.
tox.level.2.people: Moderate: marked pain or swelling, or repeated vomiting; call a doctor or a poison line.
tox.level.3.people: Severe: can harm the heart, nerves or organs; an emergency, get medical help at once.
tox.guide: A general guide, not medical or veterinary advice. Sources differ, and the effect depends on the plant part and the amount. If someone has eaten or touched a plant and feels unwell, contact a doctor, a vet or a poison line.
drainage.no_hole: Pot with no hole (plant sits in it directly)
awaycare.heading: Looking after plants while you are away
awaycare.stretch: Next time away: {from} to {to} ({n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}).
awaycare.s.nothing_needed: Nothing special: water them before you go and they will be fine.
awaycare.s.water_before: Water thoroughly just before you leave and let them drain. Skip this if a plant was watered in the last third of its interval.
awaycare.s.cooler_spot: Move them out of direct sun to a cooler, central spot with indirect light; they use water much more slowly there.
awaycare.s.pebble_tray: Stand the pot on pebbles in a tray of water (the pot base must stay above the water).
awaycare.s.matting: Put them in a sink or bath on damp capillary matting or soaked towels. Only for plants that like to stay moist.
awaycare.s.wick: Run a cotton cord from a raised water container into the soil. Test it a week before you go.
awaycare.s.reservoir: Use a self-watering pot or a water reservoir. Only for plants that like to stay moist.
awaycare.s.sitter_visit: Ask someone to visit once a week, with written instructions.
awaycare.s.sitter_home: Over four weeks is long: take the plants to someone's home, or have someone look after them.

calibration.heading: Measure the water
calibration.intro: An optional one-time check that makes the amounts fit your pots. The estimates are fine for most people.
calibration.step1: Pick a pot whose soil is dry enough to water.
calibration.step2: Water it slowly until water reaches the saucer, and count what you pour: in your container, or in a measuring jug.
calibration.step3: Enter the amount below and say where it should apply.
calibration.plant: Test plant, the pot you measured
notice.calibrationInvalid: That measurement did not work: check the amount, and that the test pot has a size.

reminders.heading: Email reminders
reminders.intro: The self-hosted server sends one email on each watering day, through your own mail server. Leave address and server empty to switch it off.

ha.err.not_configured: Home Assistant is not set up. Put its address and a long-lived access token in green-garden-core/.env as GREEN_GARDEN_HA_URL and GREEN_GARDEN_HA_TOKEN (see .env.example), then restart the dev server.

ha.err.unreachable: Could not reach Home Assistant. Check GREEN_GARDEN_HA_URL in .env and that Home Assistant is running.

weather.help: Off by default. When it is on, your server looks up recent rain and the forecast for your home point and credits it to plants outdoors. Only the point, rounded to about 1 km, is sent, and only to your own server. Without a point, only the It rained buttons count.
